summary: The pinned source citations align with the actual files. The candidate stays within the home plus recurring-care plus completion-history scope, keeps target decisions separate from upstream facts, and covers the end-to-end home/equipment/plan/due/completion/rollover/history journey. The architecture and acceptance probe specify the API, error codes, date-only rules, atomic completion updates, and zero-write negative checks, including leap-day, month-end, year-end, future-date, oversize-note, and unknown-plan cases. Limits explicitly state that neither upstream nor target was run and that no certification is claimed.
